items.title: Xfinity Price Increase Could Be A Game Changer For Comcast (CMCSA)
items.summary: Comcast recently confirmed that Xfinity customers will face price increases from December 2026 as the business seeks to cover higher costs and continue funding its network and service investments while contending with pressure in broadband and cable TV. The move highlights how Comcast is leaning more on pricing power and fee structures at a time when fixed wireless and fiber rivals are actively targeting its broadband and video base. The next focus is how Comcast's investment narrative holds...

items.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
items.summary: Netflix (NFLX) keeps more of each sales dollar than almost every company in its peer group. Yet its stock is one of the cheapest in that group. Among five companies, Netflix ranks second on operating margin. It has the fourth-highest price to earnings ratio, which makes it the second cheapest. So is Netflix stock worth more than its competitors.
